title: Token Bucket Rate Limiter
prompt: Implement a `TokenBucket` rate limiter for throttling API/inference requests. `TokenBucket(capacity, refill_rate)` creates a bucket holding up to `capacity` tokens that refills at `refill_rate` tokens per second. `allow_request(timestamp, tokens=1)` returns `True` and consumes `tokens` if enough are available at that timestamp (refilling first based on elapsed time), otherwise returns `False` and consumes nothing.
constraints: capacity and refill_rate are positive numbers
timestamps passed to allow_request are non-decreasing (calls arrive in time order)
The bucket never holds more than capacity tokens

examples.input: bucket = TokenBucket(capacity=10, refill_rate=1); allow_request(t=0, tokens=10) then allow_request(t=0, tokens=1)

test_cases.expected: see prompt — sequence of timed calls, not a single call

hints: Track the current token count and the last-refill timestamp as state.
On each call, first compute elapsed = timestamp - last_refill_time, add elapsed * refill_rate tokens (capped at capacity), then update last_refill_time.
Only after refilling do you check whether enough tokens are available to satisfy the request.
